sizing_policy_ab.question: Which page reads more like one person's natural handwritten note? (word size consistency, baseline, legibility)
sizing_policy_ab.design: Blind pairwise A/B, order randomized per seed (random.Random(20261013)). Both arms share identical cached generate_word() outputs for the demo text at seeds 42/137/2718 (quality preset) and all 2026-10-13 compose/sizing bug fixes; they differ only in SIZING_POLICY (total_height vs zone).
sizing_policy_ab.judge: fresh-context Claude Opus 5.5 subagent, fixed rubric (size consistency, baseline, legibility, overall), images only
sizing_policy_ab.notes: User: "those qpeek comparisons were clear and obvious to select - I think this is the first time I could make such a straightforward choice".
